title: Forza Horizon 5
summary: After Xbox sign-in it never leaves the blurred loading screen: a source-built D3D12 proxy translates the NVIDIA-style descriptor layout Forza expects to D3DMetal and fills the D3D12 gaps it reaches; the Xbox UDP proxy keeps online play's socket open.

excerpts.note: The game is told a CBV/SRV/UAV descriptor is 32 bytes wide, so its descriptor pool is as large as on an NVIDIA card.
Every CPU handle the game computes at 32 bytes is mapped back to D3DMetal's real 24-byte layout.
An IPv4 option on the dual-stack Xbox socket, which macOS refuses, is applied as its IPv6 equivalent so the game keeps the socket.
